user.title: China Broadnet - Phone
user.description:
Enter your China Broadnet phone number.

Make sure the local proxy is running first (`systemctl status cbn-proxy`).

captcha.title: China Broadnet - Image captcha
captcha.description:
Read the 4 characters in the image below:

![captcha]({img_data})

> Hard to read? Check "Refresh" and submit for a new one.

sms.title: China Broadnet - SMS code
sms.description:
An SMS has been sent to {phone}. Enter the code you received.

(The image captcha is submitted together with it.)

error.proxy_unreachable: Cannot reach the proxy service. Check that cbn-proxy is running
error.captcha_failed: Failed to fetch the image captcha, please retry
error.cannot_send_code: Failed to send SMS. Retry or check the phone number
error.login_failed: Login failed. Check the SMS code

abort.already_configured: This phone number is already configured

menu_options.relogin: Log in again (when the session expired)

relogin.title: Log in again
relogin.description:
Account: {phone}

**Step 1**: read the image captcha below and submit; an SMS will be sent.

![captcha]({img_data})

Check "Refresh" if unclear.

error.captcha_wrong: Image captcha was wrong. A new one was fetched, please retry
error.captcha_failed: Failed to fetch the image captcha
